verifications.implication_for_card: The $7.04 target's structural basis (84% x $1.58B, 0.50x P/NAV re-rate) is at risk of being mis-specified on the very day the catalyst fires: the company itself says all options including an asset-level change of control are being considered, with the StanChart process expected to conclude 'shortly' (June 8 PR) — a partial sell-down (finding's 30-49% case) cuts attributable NAV to 0.84x(1-x)xNPV plus whatever cash/carry terms are struck, and a 100% sale converts LZM into cash+royalty/tech, so the card needs an explicit deal-structure scenario branch before the catalyst, not after. The equity hole is real: ~$340-500M equity cheque (60/40 structure) vs $345M market cap, $15.3M cash at Mar 31 and only $18.3M Taurus headroom, and spot nickel (~$16.4k/t, $7.45/lb) is now ~12% below the $8.49/lb FS deck with the RKAB July-31 revision window a live bearish overhang — supporting the finding's smaller-debt/bigger-equity-hole mechanics. The $2.60 floor is two-sided: financing-failure probability looks LOWER than at underwriting (DFC DD complete, multiple offers, process near conclusion), but weak nickel plus dilution overhang keeps the floor level itself defensible. The 2026-12-31 milestone survives but with zero slack: company language slid from mid-2026 (Dec 2025) to late-2026 (Mar 2026 FY results), and the near-term dated event is now the strategic-process conclusion, which the card does not separately date. Net: keep WATCH; re-underwrite the SoP conditional on announced deal structure; the finding stands with one attribution nuance (change-of-control wording came in the June 8 PR and term-sheet language via the call/Crux, not verbatim in the Apr 30 Q1 PR) and one checklist correction (Taurus is $60M, not $68M — the board card already had this right).

verifications.implication_for_card: The finding survives adversarial review and the card's structure holds, with three calibration notes. (1) $7.04 target: the NAV inputs it rests on are verbatim-correct (NPV $1.58B @ $8.49/lb, 84% attributable, 89.9M shares confirmed by $345M mcap / $3.84), and the finding's core argument — that the catalyst is financing/policy-driven, not LME-driven — is factually supported (DFC dd complete Q1-26, StanChart multiple offers per company PR, June-26 State House resolution of investor-state structural issues, ~67% of mined supply quota-administered by Jakarta). But note spot Ni is $7.44/lb, ~12% below the FS deck; a spot-marked NAV would be materially lower, so the $7.04 is deck-price NAV cushioned only by the 0.50x haircut — the LME print prices the TERMS, as the finding says, and weaker terms at spot argue for keeping $7.04 as a cap, not raising it. (2) 2026-12-31 milestone: still the right date, now with less slack — the company's own 'mid-2026' financial-close target (Dec-11-25 PR) has effectively lapsed unannounced and coverage says late-2026, so Dec-31 is the operative window with early-2027 slip as a live tail risk; the two verifiable interim triggers are exactly as the finding states: the ~July-31 RKAB supplementary-quota outcome and any disclosed StanChart term-sheet conversion (offers exist, no term sheets disclosed — the G2 concrete-commitment fail stands, WATCH tier remains correct). (3) $2.60 floor: intact — it was built for financing-failure and is spot-independent; stock at $3.84 sits below the $4.40 April raise (real-money mark above market) and above the $3.07 52-wk low. One caution for the card text: cite Taurus as a $60M facility ($18.3M undrawn) with ~$68M April liquidity — not a '$68M facility' — and note DFC completion is due diligence, not a funding decision.

Target is DUAL-MARKED: $7.04 is a deck-price cap (FS deck $8.49/lb Ni, verified) conditional on FID/partner terms struck on a long-term deck; spot Ni ~$7.43/lb (6-mo low, ~14% below deck) marks the same formula at ~$4.82 (band $4.47-5.20 via Lifezone's own FS NPV sensitivity). hallucination_audit.overall: The user's 'full of hallucinations' suspicion is NOT supported: across 14 audited claims there are ZERO hallucinations — every fact asserted by the board card and the 07-02 CRO exists in the live record, and the FS substrate verified verbatim. There is exactly ONE wrong number (the board floor's stated 0.18x basis reproduces $2.32, not $2.60 — a label/arithmetic mismatch dating to 06-06, found by our own blind re-underwrite). What the user detected is real but is architectural, not epistemic: eight claims are ACCURATE_BUT_INCOMPLETE because the CRO's mandate explicitly forbade re-underwriting the target/floor, so exact arithmetic was run on a 24-day-old deck that a -14% nickel move (June RKAB whipsaw) had invalidated — the kill-line test passed on the build deck (2.93) while failing on the spot deck (0.76-0.96). No lane in the 07-02 pipeline owned re-marking commodity-linked SoP axes between board asof and seat date. Recommended fix: a deck-mark gate at CRO time for any commodity-deck SoP card (auto-recompute the target at spot via the issuer's own published sensitivity; kill-line must pass on BOTH decks or the seat blocks/escalates), plus a structure-branch requirement when change-of-control is publicly on the table.
hallucination_audit.convergence_with_external: STRONG convergence — the blind same-day production dossier (D), which never saw the external findings, independently reached the external reviewer's substance on every major axis: (1) deck fails at spot (D: Ni 8-12% below deck, spot FV $5.55-6.06; external: 14% below, spot FV $4.47-5.20 — same direction/mechanism, D's margin-scaling method understates the haircut because NPV compresses faster than margin, so the adversarially-anchored company-sensitivity band supersedes it); (2) milestone drift mid-2026 -> H2/late-2026 with 12-31 as outer bound and PENDING_SOFT status — near-verbatim agreement; (3) financing fragility ($15.3M cash, ~$10M/qtr burn, $41.7M drawn Taurus, waivers) — identical; (4) StanChart multiple-offers/no-binding state — identical; (5) D additionally caught the $2.60->$2.32 floor arithmetic error that the external review missed entirely. Divergences are minor: D did not model the change-of-control/attributable-% scenario branch (external finding 2's core contribution) and its spot-FV band ran ~15% generous. CONCLUSION: the pipeline model demonstrably CAN re-underwrite this name correctly when asked — the 07-02 divergence the user saw was a MANDATE gap (nobody on 07-02 was tasked with re-marking the axes), not model unreliability or hallucination.
